skills.name: brand-review

skills.name: brand-system

skills.name: content-waterfall
skills.description: Run a weekly content waterfall: find the idea of the week from what is hot on YouTube, X and LinkedIn, make 1 long video, grow its 3 roots into posts on every platform, ship the week and turn the engagers into conversations. Use when the author gives the idea of the week, wants posts from a video, hands over a recording or YouTube link, or asks to repurpose. Orchestrates the stage skills.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: diorama-3d
skills.description: Build a 3D diorama graphic in three.js that tells a system as a place (a room, a factory floor, a machine line), with the roles and tools as glossy toys, labels projected from 3D, a 2-second build-in and a seamless loop, exported as a 1080 x 1350 still, MP4 and GIF. Use for a 3D or animated system graphic for a post or lead magnet; flat posters stay in graphics-designer and editable process maps in flowchart.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: flowchart

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: graphics-designer

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: launch-video

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: lead-magnet-creator

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: lead-magnet-delivery
skills.description: Turn a LinkedIn lead-magnet post ("comment KEYWORD and I'll send it") into automatic delivery on OXYGEN. Every commenter who asks gets a DM with the link and a public "Sent it over:)" reply; 2nd-degree commenters are asked to connect first; nobody is messaged twice. Use when a lead-magnet post is live and the author asks to set up delivery or send the resource to commenters.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: linkedin-article-adapter
skills.description: Adapt a finished X Article into a native LinkedIn article while preserving its text and inline figures, recompose the cover at LinkedIn's article ratio, and prepare a numbered upload folder plus a short post to share it. Use after x-article-writer when the author wants the same article on LinkedIn.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: linkedin-copywriter

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: linkedin-engage
skills.description: Find fresh posts from the author's LinkedIn watchlist through OXYGEN's managed scraper, draft 1 or 2 natural comments each where the author has a real receipt, and publish a Copy & open queue page that learns from what they actually post. Use for a LinkedIn comment round or to grow reach through comments; it never comments, likes or messages on its own.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: linkedin-hook-writer
skills.description: Write, revise or compare LinkedIn hooks in the author's voice, with measured character counts and mobile-first opening budgets. Use for hook options, first-line edits, or the opening pass inside linkedin-copywriter.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: linkedin-unibox-reply
skills.description: Draft LinkedIn DM replies in the author's voice for Unibox triage and 1:1 follow-ups, one at a time, and never send without the author's yes. Use to triage interested or unanswered LinkedIn threads, draft a DM reply, or rewrite a generic suggested reply into the author's voice.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: long-form

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: shorts-cut

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: shorts-edit
skills.description: Turn raw talking-head recordings into finished shorts using reviewed take selection, audio, captions, cue-based graphics and final QA.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: shorts-motion
skills.description: Add readable, cue-aligned graphics to a short without obscuring the speaker, captions or the meaning of the footage.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: shorts-qa
skills.description: Verify an edited video for complete speech, correct captions, synchronized graphics, audio integrity, image quality and playback.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: talking-head-video-cut
skills.description: Cut and merge raw OBS or screen-recorded talking-head clips by selecting complete takes, trimming dead air and setup transitions, preserving the native picture, and QAing every join. Use for "remove the pauses", "cut the false starts", "just cut and merge" or a clean long-form YouTube cut.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: video-editor
skills.description: Turn a raw talking-head or screen-demo recording, or a short, into a publish-ready edit in 1 run, in a clean caption style (off-white word-by-word captions, serif payoffs, interludes, hard reframes, no boxes), with overlays timed to the spoken word, -14 LUFS audio, an editable DaVinci Resolve timeline and a QA sheet. Use for "edit this video", "make it publish ready" or "add captions"; it uses talking-head-video-cut for the cut and its bundled Remotion overlay kit for graphics.

Use for a daily X reply round or to grow reach through replies; it never posts, likes or follows on its own.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.description: Plan the author's X posts together with them, day by day, from 3 lanes: LinkedIn posts repurposed for X, native posts from what is going viral in their niche, and their own launches or assets. Presents a slate for the author to pick and cut, drafts the picks, records their verdicts. Use when planning X for the week or when the content waterfall hands over micro posts and chapter threads.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: x-research
skills.description: Research X posts and conversations in the author's niche and turn the strongest ones into sourced content ideas and angles the author can support with their own evidence. Use for niche trend scans, finding strong posts, creator research or building an X creator watchlist; it produces research briefs, not published posts.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: youtube-thumbnail
skills.description: Design a legible YouTube thumbnail whose visual promise is supported by the actual video.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: youtube-title-outlier-packaging
skills.description: Find YouTube packaging outliers in the author's niche, draft 2 A/B titles from proven structures with every claim marked, and brief thumbnail concepts. Use when choosing or split-testing a YouTube title or packaging a video before recording.
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan

skills.name: youtube-video-research
skills.description: Decide the author's next YouTube video before they record it, in 3 gates. An idea found depth-first inside their niche (a wave that is hot now, applied to their audience's outcome while the niche angle is still open), packaging proven by outliers in other niches, and the first 60 seconds scripted word for word. Ends in a go or no-go scorecard and logs every upload in a channel ledger. Use for "what should my next video be", "is this a good video idea", "validate this title or thumbnail" or "script the intro".
skills.author: Aditya Chouhan
